steps.title: App composition and Feature lifecycle
steps.purpose: Bind trusted context, registry, policies, owned resources and explicit adapters without starting a second session manager.
conditions: AI is explicitly enabled; current Feature signal and App scope are supplied.
bypasses: AI disabled: no provider, storage or network work.

steps.title: Capability and contract discovery
steps.purpose: Read the admitted registry and return exact identity, purpose, fields and selected contracts; preserve ambiguous and missing outcomes.
conditions: The trusted registry and owner exposure policy supply candidates; model calls pass the host boundary.
bypasses: Known exact operations execute without discovery.

steps.title: Authorized Knowledge access
steps.purpose: Resolve selected passive content with current authorization and source revisions through an injected content source.
conditions: Trusted principal and scope are injected; model calls pass host admission.
bypasses: No Knowledge requested: no content load.

steps.title: Invocation admission and composition
steps.purpose: Pin the invocation contract, resolve explicit dependencies, validate destination values and dispatch through existing invoker/recipe owners.
conditions: Registry revision, input references and injected validator are valid before each leaf dispatch.
Only owner-declared independent preparation overlaps; all active work settles before close.
Consume validated complete internal results through the existing recipe output map even when retain is absent and delivery is status-only.
Call an explicitly registered App syntax adapter only after authored-envelope admission; admit its existing recipe-format output before execution. Never interpret Design stages/apply in generic code.
Observe App-selected transaction policy; a completed step receipt is not proof of final canonical commit.
bypasses: Direct calls omit recipe coordination but use the same secured invocation boundary.
allowedContributors: Existing invoker, recipe admission and execution

steps.title: Translate App-authored request syntax
steps.purpose: Translate Design stage/apply grammar and step identities into the existing Runtime recipe format without executing mutations.
conditions: Host pins and admits the authored contract first; only its explicitly registered syntax adapter may translate.
Return normalized steps/bindings or an owned translation error to the host; runtime recipe admission and destination validation remain mandatory.
bypasses: Ordinary registered calls and existing recipe inputs need no App syntax adapter; non-Design consumers need no Design grammar.
forbiddenContributors: Design syntax interpretation in generic Runtime
A second recipe language or executor

steps.title: Canonical domain execution
steps.ownerPackage: App canonical execution and transaction adapter
steps.purpose: Run authorized domain work through its existing common APIs and transaction owner; produce complete output and owned settlement.
conditions: Actual target, permission and state checks pass at the canonical owner.
The existing transaction adapter settles the selected policy: Runtime default rollback or explicitly selected preserve-progress. Leaf receipts may precede final settlement; preserve unknown outcomes.
bypasses: Read/prepare tools do not create a canonical mutation transaction.
allowedContributors: Existing Core and Factory public APIs

steps.title: Validate and select results
steps.purpose: Reuse the existing invoker/result inspector for complete owner output, return internal values to composition, and separately select validated saved and model-facing views.
conditions: Execution status and settlement come from the owner, not from text parsing.
Per-request selectors respect per-tool external visibility.
Internal result inspection is the existing invocation validation boundary, not a second engine or a validation bypass based on a projected view.
bypasses: No custom delivery: preserve declared default independently of retain.
forbiddenContributors: Accepting invalid full results because a projection passes
Inferring images from Design action names
Turning delivery failure into unexecuted mutation

steps.title: App-scoped result storage
steps.purpose: Save requested values and provenance, return descriptions, and resolve later selected paths under trusted conversation and document scope.
conditions: Scope and resource validity are checked on access; retention is explicit.
bypasses: No retain or saved reference requested: no result-store operation.
forbiddenContributors: Persisting request leases as durable values
Changing delivery defaults because retention is enabled

steps.title: Provider transport and session continuity
steps.purpose: Describe tools, transport explicit content and receipts, and return model calls through the same live session where supported.
conditions: App selects endpoint, credentials, model and capabilities; schema transformation preserves supported semantics.
Invalid tool arguments receive a failure reply without closing a usable native session.
bypasses: Custom/HTTP providers need not implement native session continuation.
forbiddenContributors: 101 report or stop policy in production adapter

steps.title: Owned cleanup and terminal presentation
steps.purpose: Settle Feature/UI state from actual execution and delivery; dispose only owned host/provider resources after active work settles.
conditions: Completion, abort or explicit owner shutdown; settlement information remains intact.
Final presentation consumes actual App transaction settlement separately from leaf receipts; never infer committed or rolled-back state from delivery status.
bypasses: Borrowed adapters and retained conversation stores remain with their owners.
forbiddenContributors: Replaying writes to complete diagnostic reports

invariants.statement: Reuse existing registry/invoker/recipe/Knowledge owners; App canonical authority remains unchanged.
Retention, delivery and observer failures never erase acknowledged canonical execution or cause automatic mutation replay.
Complete internal handoff does not require retention and cannot be reconstructed from a model projection.
The shared host preserves execution evidence and App-selected rollback/commit policy without deciding final canonical state.
App grammar translation produces existing recipe inputs and never bypasses Runtime admission or executes mutations.

acceptanceContracts.title: Non-Design public consumer and Design preservation
assertions: Bind and execute C01-C12 against actual public runtime and provider paths.
Fault injection must fail while legal conversions and partial results pass.
No aggregate pass count or manual document review proves product correctness.

acceptanceContracts.title: Default rollback remains supported
assertions: A fatal invocation failure under the default policy rolls back through the actual App transaction adapter.
Verify final state and settlement; do not misreport an earlier step receipt as final commit.

acceptanceContracts.title: Explicit preserve-progress remains an App choice
assertions: An explicitly selected preserve-progress variant reports the actual retained state and transaction result.
Input correction and delivery/storage errors remain distinct; no automatic mutation replay or assumed commit on unknown settlement.

acceptanceContracts.title: One connected public Runtime and provider journey
assertions: Start at createAiAgentRuntime(...).run and cross the production provider, bidirectional exchange, host, secured executor and provider successor in the same fixture.
Only model endpoint, domain state and App transaction/storage adapters may be test implementations; shared invocation, validation, projection and transports are production code.

Observe provider wire contracts/content, destination arguments, state/settlement, store reads and write counts. Exercise correction within the live session, unnamed internal results, two images and later-turn reuse without fixture reinjection.
Run both transaction policy failure variants and deliberately broken handoffs on the same path; separate helper successes cannot substitute.

observations.summary: Public host assembly reuses registry, invoker, recipe admission, persistence and owner leases. Inventory journey and Design host suites verify direct/composed dispatch and rejection without replay.

Design authored stages, apply and canvas grouping remain in local-result-delivery and Design planners. The inventory consumer imports public Runtime exports and uses ordinary recipes without Design grammar.

Canonical executors, permissions and transaction adapters remain App-owned. Inventory failure variants assert actual rollback and preserve-progress state; existing Design canonical/browser cases pass.

Schema entry pins and validates complete owner output before selecting external views. Internal visibility cannot remove successor values; schema/native/result tests and corruption cases preserve type and lifetime rejection.

Portable purpose/field matching and optional information pagination take App catalogs and budgets. Arbitrary inventory tool names resolve by metadata; Design discovery and contract acquisition regressions pass.

Runtime retains Knowledge access ownership; optional file loader owns only parsing and lazy resource lifetime. Inventory discovery/read/redisplay and existing authorization/revision cases pass; Design content stays App-owned.

App injects the result store and explicitly owns release. Full values, named paths and selected images cross turns without a new producer. Borrowed stores survive provider disposal; async exchange is awaited.

Production HTTP exchange carries actual contracts, execution receipts and selected images. Extracted native RPC transport is exercised by existing offline CLI handoffs; App prompts, endpoints, model settings and evaluation policy stay App-owned.

Portable root imports exclude Node and Lodash; schema is a documented optional Lodash peer at the existing version. Non-Design consumer uses the same public built host/provider/runtime route, and Design imports current entries only.

Owned native/SQLite/Knowledge/queue cleanup retains existing cancellation semantics. Borrowed result storage survives disposal and explicit owned release occurs once; full native, lifecycle and browser suites pass.

All C01-C12 boundaries reviewed against the current contract. Twelve public-export inventory journeys passed, including corruption controls, actual rollback/preserve-progress, private internal bindings, cross-turn Knowledge/media and borrowed storage lifetime. Complete unchanged-source Design verification passed all five groups; exact prior failures were remapped and rerun, with no unresolved warning. No legacy forwarding entry, Design syntax in Runtime or weakened validation remains in the transfer.
